bug_semantics: An authenticated caller can send PUT /api/supplier/{id} with another tenant's supplier ID. SupplierRequest::authorize() checks only Auth::check(), SupplierUpdateController resolves the attacker-controlled ID globally with Supplier::find($id), and update($request->all()) mass-assigns body fields against Supplier::$fillable, which includes company_id. The caller can therefore read and modify the returned foreign supplier and can reassign it by supplying company_id.
flaw_origin: The PR member commit 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee is the smallest commit that wrote the vulnerable handler: it replaced an empty update method with the unscoped lookup and whole-body update and added the authentication-only SupplierRequest. Those vulnerable controller and request blobs landed unchanged in squash aggregate b03c8c6f5fde097cbe44552464c56469b60a4369, whose version.php is 4.0.0. Commit b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 later activated the dormant handler by adding the supplier PUT route at version 4.15.0, but it did not write the authorization, lookup, or mass-assignment flaw and is therefore a later reachability event rather than the BIC under the protocol's first-vulnerable-lines rule.
ai_marker: absent — git cat-file commit 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee shows human author and committer Gustavo Novaro <gnovaro@gmail.com> and no AI trailer, bot identity, Generated-with marker, or other commit-object AI signal
evidence: The assigned GHSA-4hh4-jwxc-xpmf/CVE-2026-78365 advisory identifies authenticated cross-tenant read and modification through PUT /api/supplier/{id}, attacker-controlled company_id, affected versions 4.0.0 through 5.3.1, and fix commit 4a52477e6ed66afa436814c80e7bcd68670dd596.

Resolving the introducer_sha and introducer_parent disagreement: git cat-file commit 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee reports the sole parent 37af4daadbfec766fc691555a1f124b376bd33ae. git diff of that parent to 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee shows the empty SupplierUpdateController::update(Request $request, int $id) replaced by Supplier::find($id), $supplier->update($request->all()), and a response returning the supplier; the same diff adds SupplierRequest::authorize() returning Auth::check().

The required direct-parent check resolves introducer_parent_absent: git show 37af4daadbfec766fc691555a1f124b376bd33ae:app/Http/Controllers/Api/Supplier/SupplierUpdateController.php shows only the empty update method, and git cat-file -e for app/Http/Requests/API/SupplierRequest.php at that parent fails because the request class is absent. Thus the vulnerable lookup, update, and authentication-only request are absent from the immediate parent tree.

git show 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee:app/Models/Supplier.php confirms company_id is fillable. git rev-parse returns identical controller blob f4829388d8ba029bc1356d915c061866656265cc and request blob 7e4d1160a9ba0115f8ada825f9c0b36d489511c8 for both member 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee and squash b03c8c6f5fde097cbe44552464c56469b60a4369, proving the smaller member's vulnerable code landed unchanged and resolving squash_decomposed in favor of true.

Resolving the reviewer's b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 candidate: git diff 7f05ac6d115c09dc570e002b28e126871057333e b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 -- routes/api.php version.php shows a SupplierUpdateController import, Route::put('/supplier/{id}', ...), and a version change from 4.14.0 to 4.15.0. git grep at the parent and at b03c8c6f5fde097cbe44552464c56469b60a4369 finds supplier GET and DELETE routes but no PUT route. This proves b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 is the reachability boundary, while also proving it merely exposed the already-flawed handler and did not write the vulnerable authorization, lookup, or mass-assignment lines.

The version boundary is therefore split cleanly: b03c8c6f5fde097cbe44552464c56469b60a4369:version.php is 4.0.0 and contains the dormant vulnerable code, while b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403:version.php is 4.15.0 and is the first checked tree with the described PUT route. The advisory's 4.0.0 lower bound matches the vulnerable code's presence, but the checked HTTP attack path becomes reachable at 4.15.0.

Resolving marker_state and verdict: git cat-file commit 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee shows Gustavo Novaro as author and committer and no AI signal. git cat-file commit b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 does carry Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, but that marker belongs to the later route-activation commit, not the BIC, and is excluded by the required BIC-commit-object-only attribution rule.

git diff 4a52477e6ed66afa436814c80e7bcd68670dd596^ 4a52477e6ed66afa436814c80e7bcd68670dd596 directly verifies the fix: it scopes the supplier query by Auth::user()->company_id, replaces request->all() with request->validated(), strengthens SupplierRequest authorization to the applicable permission, and changes version.php from 5.3.1 to 5.3.2. git tag --contains 4a52477e6ed66afa436814c80e7bcd68670dd596 returns v5.5.3 and v5.14.0, so the advisory-linked v5.5.3 contains the direct fix.
reasoning: The primary wins all four assigned disagreements. Its 3cef95157121a1bb5de24253d23130c7d0a38bee introducer and 37af4daadbfec766fc691555a1f124b376bd33ae parent are supported by the raw commit object, the direct parent tree, and the member-to-squash blob identities. The reviewer correctly found that b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 first made the dormant handler reachable through the advertised PUT route, but treating that later activation as the BIC conflicts with the protocol: the smallest BIC is the commit that first wrote the vulnerable lines, and aggregates, imports, and later exposure of an already-vulnerable handler are not substituted for that code-writing origin. Because the selected BIC's own commit object has no AI signal, the reviewer's Claude trailer on b233f27910f32c264243d03021e4f25dbef5f403 cannot be imported into attribution. The resolved marker is absent and the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI; the direct fix and both the dormant-code and reachable-route version boundaries are verified.
